If this dataset supports your work, please cite it. The canonical citation is defined in
[`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/blob/main/CITATION.cff)
(GitHub's **"Cite this repository"** button reads it automatically).

## BibTeX

```bibtex
@misc{BalmeoBarangayBoundaries,
  author       = {Balmeo, Manuel},
  title        = {Philippine Barangay Boundaries GeoJSON with PSGC Codes and RDF Change History},
  year         = {2026},
  howpublished = {GitHub repository},
  url          = {https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository},
  note         = {Release v2026.4.13.0 (snapshot 2023-10-24); data: PSA PSGC snapshots and NAMRIA boundaries v2023-11-06},
  license      = {MIT}
}
```

## Data attribution

This dataset redistributes and enriches government data. Please also credit the original sources:

- **Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA)** — Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) snapshots.
  <https://psa.gov.ph/classification/psgc/>

- **NAMRIA** — Administrative-boundary shapefiles, version 2023-11-06.
  <https://namria.gov.ph/>

## DOI

This project is GitHub-only for now; a Zenodo DOI is a flagged future follow-up. Until then, the
GitHub Release URL above is the persistent identifier.
